question: What is the delivered price in Ho Chi Minh City of food-grade, low-temperature defatted soy flour (stated NSI or PDI), GMO and non-GMO, from China, India and Serbia, in 2026?
why_it_matters: It is 63 to 85% of full cost and decides the sign of the margin at Chinese parity; the breakeven for a 15% margin is USD 700 to 1,076 per t at 1 t/h
cheapest_way_to_close: Five written supplier quotes (CIF Cat Lai, 20 t lots) requested by a partner chay maker or distributor
owner_org_to_ask: Shandong soy protein makers; Indian soy flour exporters; the Serbian concentrate supplier named on An Nhien labels; Brenntag Vietnam

question: What share of HS 2106.10 imports is textured protein, as opposed to concentrate powder or supplement premix, and who imports it?
why_it_matters: Sets the pool a soy line can serve (12,832 t of textured-type imports in 2025 is an upper bound) and names the buyers
cheapest_way_to_close: Declaration-level customs extract for 2106.10.00 with descriptions and importers (DMV-02, OQ-231)
owner_org_to_ask: General Department of Customs (GDVC); a trade-data vendor

question: What do chay makers buy each year (tonnes of textured soy and gluten, shapes and sizes), and would two or three of them co-invest in or pre-buy from a shared line?
why_it_matters: Converts the pool into named offtake; the SKU mix decides die changes and real utilisation; co-investment is the structure the economics favour
cheapest_way_to_close: Five calls or visits with a one-page specification and indicative price (combine with AIS-L01)
owner_org_to_ask: An Nhien (Pham Gia Phat); Au Lac; Thoai An; SG Food; Cholimex; CJ Cau Tre

question: What preferential duty do Chinese, ASEAN and Indian textured protein, gluten and food-grade soy flour pay into Vietnam in 2026 (ACFTA, ATIGA, AIFTA)?
why_it_matters: Moves the parity price by about 5% on textured protein and 10% on gluten
cheapest_way_to_close: Read Decree 118/2022/ND-CP and the ATIGA and AIFTA schedules for 2106.10, 1109 and 2304.00.21 (W7-L2)
owner_org_to_ask: W7-L2 fiscal line; Ministry of Finance

question: What do distributors charge SMEs for 20 to 25 kg bags of Chinese textured soy, and on what credit terms?
why_it_matters: This, not the border price, is the price a domestic line meets in the long tail of small buyers

question: What do firm CIF quotes for 0.5 and 1 t/h dry TVP lines with dryer and installation cost from three Shandong makers and one European maker?
why_it_matters: Turns listing prices (Low) into quotes (Medium); capex is not decisive at Chinese prices, so this matters mainly for a European-grade line
cheapest_way_to_close: Request for quotation by email with a one-page specification
owner_org_to_ask: Jinan Saibainuo; Jinan Sunward; Shandong Joyang; Buhler, Clextral or Wenger regional offices

question: Does any Vietnamese workshop already run a small Chinese TVP extruder, and has any extrusion attempt closed?
why_it_matters: Tests the clean negative on domestic extrusion and would give real operating data
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the Ho Chi Minh City dealer (FORM-34) and three Chinese vendors for Vietnamese reference customers
owner_org_to_ask: Tan Sao Bac A Machinery; Chinese vendors

question: What is the 2026 ex-works price of plain flour-based TVP in China, and how far could exporters cut it?
why_it_matters: Defensibility: the Chinese spread over flour is about USD 630 per t on 2025 unit values
cheapest_way_to_close: Buyer-style request for quotation to three Chinese TVP makers
owner_org_to_ask: Chinese TVP makers (via a Vietnamese importer)

question: Does the Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City have a food extruder that startups could rent for trials?
why_it_matters: Would give T1 and T5 a local pilot route
cheapest_way_to_close: Email the corresponding author of the 2026 HMMA paper
owner_org_to_ask: Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City
